original_description: VoxelDraft helps users create and refine 3D voxel models through short temporary model references, inspect their geometry, explore them in an interactive 3D preview inside ChatGPT, export OBJ/MTL or compact JSON files, and optionally save or reopen private projects in their VoxelDraft account.
summary_ja: ボクセルモデルを作成・確認し、OBJ/MTLなどに出力。
limitations: 非公開プロジェクトの保存・再読込は任意のアカウント機能として説明。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
